summary: Frontend-only testing completed for enterprise content detail page redesign. All 4 content types (Blogs, Case Studies, White Papers, Events) render correctly with the new ContentDetailLayout component. Enterprise-grade design elements verified including two-column layout, audio player, newsletter sidebar, related insights, author attribution, and previous/next navigation.

issues: Uses blue (bg-blue-50) for results banner instead of emerald (bg-emerald-50) like other case studies - minor inconsistency

verified_elements: Results banner with metrics (40% cost reduction, 3x faster, 95% satisfaction)
Download CTA banner with PDF button
Page count and download stats (45 Pages, 2,500+ Downloads)
Author attribution (Dr. Sarah Chen & Michael Rodriguez)
Event details banner (Date, Time, Format, Location)

tested_flows: Back to Insights link from blog detail
Case Studies listing to detail navigation

mobile_responsiveness.details: Layout adapts correctly on mobile (390x844). Sidebar stacks below main content. All key elements visible.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Healthcare case study uses bg-blue-50 for results banner instead of bg-emerald-50 (consistent with other case studies). Consider updating for visual consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 content detail page types (Blog, Case Study, White Paper, Event) verified with new enterprise ContentDetailLayout. Key features tested: two-column layout (70% content + 30% sticky sidebar), audio player, newsletter subscription, related insights, topics, author attribution, previous/next navigation, and back links. Mobile responsiveness confirmed. Color schemes verified: Blog=blue, Case Study=emerald, White Paper=purple, Event=orange.
